pt.r: O Parque Nacional da Sequoia fica na Califórnia, nos Estados Unidos. Tem 1.635 km² e está protegido desde 1890, sob gestão do Serviço Nacional de Parques dos EUA (NPS). Na classificação da IUCN, está na categoria II, a dos parques nacionais: protege ecossistemas inteiros e recebe visitantes.
pt.h: Criado em 25/09/1890, é o segundo parque nacional mais antigo dos EUA. É administrado junto com o vizinho Kings Canyon, e os dois formam desde 1976 uma reserva da biosfera da UNESCO.
pt.ff: Tem quase 4.000 m de desnível e inclui o monte Whitney (4.421 m), ponto mais alto dos EUA contíguos. A Giant Forest guarda cinco das dez maiores árvores do mundo, entre elas a General Sherman, a maior árvore da Terra em volume. Ursos-negros, cervos-mula e marmotas são comuns.
at: Árvore General Sherman e a Giant Forest

en.r: Sequoia National Park is a national park in California, United States. It covers 1,635 km² and has been protected since 1890. It is managed by the U.S. National Park Service. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: Established on 25 September 1890, it is the second-oldest US national park. It is managed together with neighbouring Kings Canyon, and since 1976 the two form a UNESCO biosphere reserve.
en.ff: With nearly 4,000 m of relief, it includes Mount Whitney (4,421 m), the highest point in the contiguous US. The Giant Forest holds five of the world's ten largest trees, including the General Sherman, the largest tree on Earth by volume. Black bears, mule deer and marmots are common.
at: General Sherman Tree and the Giant Forest

es.r: El Sequoia National Park es un parque nacional en California, Estados Unidos. Tiene 1.635 km² y está protegido desde 1890, bajo la gestión del Servicio de Parques Nacionales de EE. UU.. En la clasificación de la UICN está en la categoría II, la de los parques nacionales: protege ecosistemas enteros y recibe visitantes.
es.h: Creado el 25/09/1890, es el segundo parque nacional más antiguo de EE. UU. Se administra junto con el vecino Kings Canyon, y desde 1976 ambos forman una reserva de la biosfera de la UNESCO.
es.ff: Con casi 4.000 m de desnivel, incluye el monte Whitney (4.421 m), el punto más alto de los EE. UU. contiguos. La Giant Forest guarda cinco de los diez árboles más grandes del mundo, entre ellos el General Sherman, el mayor de la Tierra en volumen. Osos negros, ciervos mulos y marmotas son comunes.
at: Árbol General Sherman y la Giant Forest

pt.r: O Parque Nacional de Redwood fica na Califórnia, nos Estados Unidos. Tem 315 km² e está protegido desde 1968, sob gestão do Serviço Nacional de Parques dos EUA (NPS). Na classificação da IUCN, é uma paisagem protegida, onde natureza e uso humano tradicional convivem.
pt.h: O parque nacional foi criado em 1968, depois de décadas de corte intensivo, e é gerido junto com três parques estaduais da Califórnia. Patrimônio Mundial da UNESCO desde 1980. Os povos yurok, tolowa e chilula vivem na região há milhares de anos.
pt.ff: O conjunto protege 45% das florestas antigas de sequoia-vermelha que restam, a árvore mais alta da Terra. Também guarda 60 km de costa, pradarias com manadas de alces-de-roosevelt, salmões e leões-marinhos.
at: Alces na pradaria de Elk Prairie

en.r: Redwood National Park is a national park in California, United States. It covers 315 km² and has been protected since 1968. It is managed by the U.S. National Park Service. Under the IUCN system it is a protected landscape, where nature and traditional human use coexist.
en.h: The national park was created in 1968, after decades of heavy logging, and is managed with three California state parks. It has been a UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1980. The Yurok, Tolowa and Chilula peoples have lived here for thousands of years.
en.ff: The complex protects 45% of the remaining old-growth coast redwood, the tallest tree on Earth. It also holds 60 km of coastline, prairies with Roosevelt elk herds, salmon and sea lions.

es.h: El parque nacional se creó en 1968, tras décadas de tala intensa, y se gestiona junto con tres parques estatales de California. Es Patrimonio Mundial de la UNESCO desde 1980. Los pueblos yurok, tolowa y chilula viven en la zona desde hace miles de años.
es.ff: El conjunto protege el 45% de los bosques antiguos de secuoya roja que quedan, el árbol más alto de la Tierra. También guarda 60 km de costa, praderas con manadas de wapitíes de Roosevelt, salmones y leones marinos.

en.r: Joshua Tree National Park is a national park in California, United States. It covers 3,196 km² and has been protected since 1994. It is managed by the U.S. National Park Service. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: Minerva Hoyt campaigned to protect the desert, and Franklin D. Roosevelt created the national monument in 1936. It became a national park on 31 October 1994. It is sacred to peoples such as the Cahuilla and Serrano.
en.ff: Two deserts meet: the higher Mojave, home of the Joshua tree, an endemic yucca, and the lower Colorado, with cholla and ocotillo gardens. Rounded granite formations, palm oases and bighorn sheep.

en.r: Kings Canyon National Park is a national park in California, United States. It covers 1,869 km² and has been protected since 1940. It is managed by the U.S. National Park Service. en.h: It began in 1890 as General Grant National Park and was greatly expanded and renamed on 4 March 1940. It is managed together with Sequoia.
en.ff: Kings Canyon is a glacier-carved valley over 1,600 m deep, among the deepest in North America. Peaks over 4,300 m, mountain meadows, swift rivers and giant sequoia groves, including the General Grant Tree, the second largest in the world.

en.r: Desolation Wilderness is a wilderness area in California, United States. It covers 259 km² and has been protected since 1969. It is managed by the U.S. Forest Service. Under the IUCN system it is a wilderness area: a large, largely unmodified space without permanent infrastructure.
en.h: The Washoe used the area before Europeans arrived; it was later called "Devil's Valley" and grazed by cattle. It became a forest reserve in the late 19th century and a primitive area in 1931 before wilderness designation.
en.ff: Glacier-polished granite, dozens of alpine lakes and the Sierra Nevada crest, just west of Lake Tahoe.

pt.r: O Parque Nacional de Lassen Volcanic fica na Califórnia, nos Estados Unidos. Tem 431 km² e está protegido desde 1916, sob gestão do Serviço Nacional de Parques dos EUA (NPS). Na classificação da IUCN, está na categoria II, a dos parques nacionais: protege ecossistemas inteiros e recebe visitantes.
pt.h: O pico Lassen entrou em erupção entre 1914 e 1917, e o parque foi criado em 09/08/1916. Os atsugewi, yana, yahi e maidu viviam ao redor da montanha.
pt.ff: O pico Lassen é o maior domo de lava do mundo e o vulcão mais ao sul da cordilheira das Cascatas. O parque tem os quatro tipos de vulcão: domo, escudo, cone de cinzas e estratovulcão, além de fumarolas, lama fervente e lagos de montanha.

en.r: Lassen Volcanic National Park is a national park in California, United States. It covers 431 km² and has been protected since 1916. It is managed by the U.S. National Park Service. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: Lassen Peak erupted between 1914 and 1917, and the park was created on 9 August 1916. The Atsugewi, Yana, Yahi and Maidu lived around the mountain.
en.ff: Lassen Peak is the largest plug dome volcano in the world and the southernmost volcano of the Cascade Range. The park has all four volcano types, plug dome, shield, cinder cone and stratovolcano, plus fumaroles, boiling mud and mountain lakes.

es.ff: El pico Lassen es el mayor domo de lava del mundo y el volcán más austral de la cordillera de las Cascadas. El parque tiene los cuatro tipos de volcán: domo, escudo, cono de ceniza y estratovolcán, además de fumarolas, lodo hirviente y lagos de montaña.

pt.r: O Pinnacles National Park é um parque nacional na Califórnia, nos Estados Unidos. Tem 108 km² e está protegido desde 2013, sob gestão do Serviço Nacional de Parques dos EUA (NPS). Na classificação da IUCN, está na categoria II, a dos parques nacionais: protege ecossistemas inteiros e recebe visitantes.
pt.h: Theodore Roosevelt criou o monumento nacional em 1908. Virou parque nacional em 10/01/2013.
pt.ff: Os pináculos são o que resta da metade oeste de um vulcão extinto, arrastado 320 km pela falha de San Andreas. Cavernas de tálus formadas por rochas caídas abrigam morcegos, e o condor-da-califórnia foi reintroduzido no parque.
at: Cavernas de tálus Bear Gulch e Balconies

en.r: Pinnacles National Park is a national park in California, United States. It covers 108 km² and has been protected since 2013. It is managed by the U.S. National Park Service. Under the IUCN system it is category II, the national park category: it protects whole ecosystems and welcomes visitors.
en.h: Theodore Roosevelt created the national monument in 1908. It became a national park on 10 January 2013.
en.ff: The pinnacles are what remains of the western half of an extinct volcano, carried 320 km along the San Andreas Fault. Talus caves formed by fallen boulders shelter bats, and California condors have been reintroduced here.
at: Bear Gulch and Balconies talus caves
